描述_EN: fans formed one of the most significant types of chinese export objects in ivory. indeed, ivory fans were made solely for export. on 18th-century examples the ivory is treated as a surface for painting and gilding. the decoration on this fan comprises flowers, mythical beasts and european figures.
描述_ZN: 扇子是中国出口的象牙制品中最重要的类型之一。 事实上，象牙扇只为出口而制作。 在18世纪的例子中，象牙被当作绘画和镀金的表面。 这把扇子上的装饰包括花朵、神兽和欧洲人物。
